title: Democratizing Cross-Project Knowledge for Transforming Water Governance and Climate Resilience: an Agentic AI Ecosystem
abstract: arXiv:2611.26398v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: EU-funded projects produce extensive evidence in the form of deliverables, reports, and case studies. However, this knowledge is typically scattered across projects and document structures, making it difficult to locate relevant, contextual information when making decisions. This paper introduces an Agentic AI Ecosystem that consolidates heterogeneous project documentation into a domain-aware knowledge base and provides adaptive access through an agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipeline. Documents from three EU-funded projects (IMPETUS, NATALIE, and InnWater) are reconstructed into hierarchical section trees and indexed with structured metadata. Retrieval is supported by two domain-specific embedding models fine-tuned on domain data (water and climate). On top of this knowledge base, a ReAct-style controller iteratively orchestrates retrieval actions by allocating retrieval budget across domain collections and accumulating evide

translated_title: 民主化跨项目知识以变革水治理与气候韧性：一个智能体AI生态系统
translated_abstract: 欧盟资助的项目以交付成果、报告和案例研究的形式产生了大量证据。然而，这些知识通常分散在不同项目和文档结构之中，使得决策时难以定位相关且具有情境的信息。本文提出了一个智能体AI生态系统，它将异构的项目文档整合为一个领域感知的知识库，并通过智能体检索增强生成流水线提供自适应访问。来自三个欧盟资助项目（IMPETUS、NATALIE和InnWater）的文档被重构为层次化章节树，并使用结构化元数据进行索引。检索由两个在领域数据（水和气候）上微调的领域特定嵌入模型提供支持。在该知识库之上，一个ReAct风格的控制器通过在领域集合之间分配检索预算并积累证据，迭代地编排检索动作。
tldr: 本文提出了一个智能体AI生态系统，将三个欧盟项目的异构文档整合为领域感知知识库，结合领域微调嵌入模型与ReAct式智能体检索增强生成流水线，实现跨项目知识的自适应访问，以服务水治理与气候韧性决策。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces an Agentic AI Ecosystem that consolidates heterogeneous documentation from three EU-funded projects into a domain-aware knowledge base, enabling adaptive cross-project knowledge access for water governance and climate resilience through domain-tuned embedding models and a ReAct-style agentic RAG pipeline.
